title: Action on Entity Set (Entity Action) date: 2024-01-07

Action on Entity Set

Entity Action Types

Executes a bi-entity action on entities stored in an Entity Set (Power Type). This allows you to perform actions on all entities in a set with optional filtering and limits.

Type ID: sync:action_on_entity_set

Fields

Field Type Default Description
set Power Type The Entity Set power to act upon
bientity_action Bi-Entity Action Action to execute on each entity in the set
bientity_condition Bi-Entity Condition optional Condition to filter which entities receive the action
limit Integer 0 Maximum number of entities to affect (0 = no limit)
reverse Boolean false Whether to process entities in reverse order

Notes

  • The action receives a pair: (owner_of_set, entity_in_set)
  • If limit is set, only that many entities will be affected (starting from the beginning or end if reversed)

Examples

{
    "type": "sync:action_on_entity_set",
    "set": {
        "power": "mymod:my_entity_set"
    },
    "bientity_action": {
        "type": "apoli:apply_effect",
        "effect": {
            "effect": "minecraft:glowing",
            "duration": 200,
            "amplifier": 0,
            "show_particles": false
        }
    },
    "limit": 5,
    "condition": {
        "type": "apoli:sneaking"
    }
}

This example applies glowing to up to 5 entities in the set when sneaking.
